response.courseDescription: 438 Microfabrication Technology Microelectronic fabrication technology, semiconductor material, diffusion, thermal oxidation, ion implantation, lithography, etching, thin film deposition, CMOS integration and MEMS. Credit not granted for both MECH 438 and MECH 538.
response.coursePrerequisites: CHEM 105; MATH 315; 4 credits of PHYSICS 202, or PHYSICS 202 and 212.
